prompt: Who is the first Republican president of the United States to serve non-consecutive terms?
answer: Donald Trump is the first Republican president to serve two non-consecutive terms. He served as the 45th president from 2017–2021 and began serving as the 47th president on January 20, 2025. Grover Cleveland was the first president overall to do so.
